name: milestone-tracker
description: A pane beside the chat that tracks the workflow's phases, steps, Claude's tasks and Orca agents

orcaCommand.title: Orca command
orcaCommand.description: The Orca CLI to run. "auto" tries orca (orca.exe, orca.cmd on Windows; orca-ide on Linux). Set a full path if Orca isn't found.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often Orca agents, worktrees and the branch are re-read. PRs refresh every fourth time.

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts, if the window is wide enough.
